# t_funcs.intp { #maxwellbloch.t_funcs.intp }

```python
t_funcs.intp(index)
```

Return an interpolated time function.

Linearly interpolates a user-supplied ``(tlist, ylist)`` pair, returning
zero outside the supplied range.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``tlist_{index}`` and               |
|        | TFunc  | ``ylist_{index}`` from args. Returns a Python complex scalar when   |
|        | TFunc  | called with scalar ``t`` (as required by QuTiP 5), or an array when |
|        | TFunc  | called with array ``t``.                                            |
